items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: So Amy would play bass. He may have played better than me, but he would have filled in until he learned. But he wanted to go back to England. He had other things that he wanted to tent over there. So I bought Amy or Cher out so he could get enough money to go back to England.

ctx.x: I forgot certain incidents at places like we played in London before we came back to America. We were asked by the British government to play at the Savoy Hotel. That was a celebration of the Peace Victory Ball. Yeah we worked to play the dance music and we went on over there after they had all the parades and all kinds of ceremonies in the street all day. People were kissing one another. Men were even kissing you on the street. They were so happy. That night we went over to the Savoy Hotel and we mounted the…

Yes that's right. We'll keep it now. This is a letter from Emil Christian and it says I would like Philip Napoleon on cornet and Johnny Costello on clarinet. The boys I was working with because they have more of an idea what I want and they can play all the Dixieland numbers because I'll know we'll get some requests for them. It's signed on the back here. Sincerely, Emil Christian, 2 Bagley Street, Tidingham Court Road, Apartment 1, London, England. And I don't see the date. Let me think. It's on the 1st. The…
